save.title: Save as preset
save.description: Save this stream's title, description, tags and other details as a reusable preset.

fields.noteHint: Optional. A short reminder of what this preset is for.

manage.title: Metadata presets
manage.description: Reusable stream details you can apply to a destination later. Applying a preset only changes local metadata - it never publishes anything.
manage.emptyDescription: Fill in a destination's stream details, then use "Save as preset" to reuse them next time.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this preset?
deleteDialog.message: "{{preset}}" will be removed. Destinations it was previously applied to keep their current metadata - deleting a preset never changes them.

apply.title: Apply "{{preset}}"
apply.description: Choose one or more destinations. Applying only changes their local stream details - nothing is published.
apply.noDestinations: Add a destination first to apply a preset to it.
apply.incompatible: This preset can't be applied to this destination as-is.

discardDialog.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discardDialog.message: The open destination has unsaved metadata changes. Applying this preset will replace them.
